mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause significant renal impairment; cyclosporine may increase zoledronic acid exposure through reduced renal clearance, elevating risk of acute kidney injury and electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and electrolytes (calcium, phosphate, magnesium) closely before and after zoledronic acid infusion; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative bisphosphonates or extended dosing intervals if renal function declines.
